description: Research into open standards for durable, sandboxed agent infrastructure, grown out of the harness that Chauffeur and SourceFed came from.
body: Began as a **custom agent harness** built on **Pi**: a fleet of coding agents on **Cloudflare** that took a ticket, planned the work and wrote the code in an isolated sandbox. Its steering rules and monitors have since become **Chauffeur** and **SourceFed**, which no longer depend on it and do far more.
Now a **research project** into open standards for agent infrastructure: an **open protocol** for **durable, sandboxed agents**. Its projects live under the **wrkhse** GitHub organisation.
The `daemon` is a **shared capability daemon** and a framework for building **modular MCP servers**.
The original fleet is kept on the `fleet-v0` branch.
